summary_en: 250,000 shares (2.86% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), ¥100M upper limit. Open-market purchases on TSE. Execution window 17 Aug 2026 – 16 Aug 2027. Purpose: capital efficiency, future M&A deployment.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Goodpatch Inc. announced on 14 August 2026 that its board has authorized a treasury share acquisition program under the Company Law Article 156 (as applied by Article 165(3)) and the company's articles of incorporation. The program will acquire up to 250,000 common shares, representing 2.86% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury), with a total expenditure cap of ¥100 million. Purchases will be executed via open-market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange over the 12-month window from 17 August 2026 through 16 August 2027. The company stated that the acquisition is intended to improve capital efficiency and shareholder returns, and to enable flexible capital allocation in the future, including potential deployment in M&A activities. As of 31 May 2026, the company held 512,847 treasury shares against 8,733,973 shares outstanding ex-treasury.
